baseline_models.focus_anchor: The future-marked reflexive remembering verb at word 1 is predicated of the relative subject defined by fearing in word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Reverent fear creates enough inward pressure for retained or neglected material to return to active awareness; the verse presents awe as a disposition that makes recollection occur.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something back to mind supplies the active recovery event performed by the subject.
Fear joined with reverent awe supplies the receptive pressure that conditions the recovery.

changed_reading.before: The line merely predicts that somebody will remember.
changed_reading.after: It identifies awe as the disposition through which latent retention becomes active recollection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same two focus verbs permit remembering to interact with the figurative knowing branch of fearing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The subject apprehends enough of a consequence or reality to retrieve what was already available but inactive; fear and knowledge remain co-present rather than mutually exclusive glosses.

activation_trace.role: Recall supplies the transition from latent retention to present cognition.
Figurative knowing makes apprehension an epistemic trigger, not only an emotion.

changed_reading.before: Fearing is only an emotional precondition for memory.
changed_reading.after: Apprehensive knowledge recognizes the stakes and thereby calls dormant knowledge back into presence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The remembering root at word 1 also carries a branch of voiced mention, while word 3 supplies awe.
baseline_models.mechanism: What begins as inward recollection can cross into naming or avowal on the tongue; the focus may describe an awed response becoming expressible, not only a silent mental event.

activation_trace.role: Mention on the tongue opens an outward verbal phase of the remembering response.
Reverent awe supplies the pressure under which inward recognition becomes voiced.

changed_reading.after: The awed subject may carry recollection across the threshold into verbal acknowledgment.

context_deltas.mechanism: A visible mark, measured formation, completed proportion, deliberate apportioning, and gentle guidance form a signal system. The apprehending subject does not merely retrieve words but recognizes guidance already impressed into an ordered creation.

activation_trace.role: Bringing something back to mind makes recognition the focus event.
The knowing branch makes the subject capable of apprehending an encoded order.
The non-dominant mapped image of a visible identifying mark supplies creation with a readable signature.
Estimating and measuring supply an intentional template behind what is made.
Straightness and intrinsic completion make the template visibly coherent.
Deliberate ordering by measure supplies design rather than accidental arrangement.
Gentle indication toward a way turns measured order into guidance that can be recognized.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from naming through creating and proportioning to measuring and guiding.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mark, measured completion, deliberate apportioning, and gentle indication; I infer that these function as a retrievable signature. A live alternative is that recollection responds only to verbal admonition, while the creation sequence merely identifies its source.

changed_reading.before: The subject retrieves previously heard content because of apprehension.
changed_reading.after: The subject apprehensively recognizes a guiding measure already marked into the ordered world.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pasture emerges, is consumed by change, and becomes dark stubble; the hidden-extraction branch lets remembrance operate like recovering a meaningful pattern from residue after its vivid surface has vanished.

activation_trace.role: Recall supplies recovery of something no longer immediately present.
Awe supplies sensitivity to the loss and transformation that provoke recovery.
Drawing something out of concealment supplies the recovery motion.
Pasture supplies the initially living and useful pattern that will be transformed.
Pasture becoming dry stubble supplies the residual state from which significance must be recovered.
Dark coloration marks the collapse of fresh visibility without requiring total disappearance.

structural_cues: The adjacent ecological sequence reverses emergence into darkened residue before the discourse turns to recitation and memory.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies emergence, pasture, stubble, and darkening; I infer an analogy between material residue and mnemonic latency. The live alternative is that this cycle only warns of transience and does not specify how remembering works.

changed_reading.before: Remembering retrieves an intact item from a mental store.
changed_reading.after: Remembering reconstructs a still-legible significance from what remains after visible vitality has collapsed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recitation gathers what could disperse into forgetting and carries it across the hidden-visible boundary under encompassing knowledge. Focus remembrance becomes enabled re-collection rather than an isolated act of unaided memory.

activation_trace.role: Recall supplies the focus event whose enabling conditions are being clarified.
Gathering and assembling make recitation a re-collection of potentially scattered content.
Reciting and causing recitation supply the voiced medium through which the gathering occurs.
Loss from memory supplies the dispersive condition that recitation and recall overcome.
Disclosure to a knower places manifest and latent content within a wider field of knowledge.
Visible manifestation supplies the exposed pole across which remembered content moves.
Concealment supplies the latent pole from which content can be brought back.

structural_cues: The promise of caused recitation and non-forgetting is followed by knowledge spanning what is manifest and hidden.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recitative gathering, forgetting, disclosure, manifestation, and concealment; I infer a movement from latent dispersion to voiced presence. A live alternative is that these clauses guarantee transmission to the reciter without describing the later hearer's recollection.

changed_reading.before: The fearing person independently retrieves a memory.
changed_reading.after: The person participates in a prior act of recitative gathering that moves content from hidden latency into renewed presence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Ease opens a path, an external reminder presents content, benefit distinguishes successful reception, and the reflexive focus verb marks the recipient's own uptake. Khashya identifies responsiveness within an enabling relay rather than acting as a lone mechanical cause.

activation_trace.role: Active recollection supplies the recipient-side completion of the relay.
Reverent awe supplies the recipient disposition that makes uptake possible.
Opening and ease after difficulty supply an enabled route toward response.
An offered reminder supplies the external input that the focus subject internalizes.
Benefit as the opposite of harm supplies the criterion by which uptake becomes effective.

structural_cues: The ordered sequence is facilitation, conditional reminding, then the prediction that the awed subject will remember.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ease, reminder, benefit, and recipient recollection; I infer a directional relay from enabling through address to uptake. A live alternative is that the three statements are coordinated assurances rather than stages in one causal process.

changed_reading.before: Fear by itself causes a memory to surface.
changed_reading.after: An eased and beneficial reminder becomes self-recollection in a recipient whose awe makes the offered content usable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next subject moves to the side and away, whereas the focus subject lets the reminder enter and become recollection. The contrast reverses the expectation that fear necessarily causes recoil: reverent fear can orient toward an address, while wretchedness performs avoidance.

activation_trace.role: Recall marks reception and inward approach to the reminder.
Awe supplies a fear that remains receptive rather than fleeing.
Withdrawal and self-distancing supply the opposed bodily orientation.
Wretchedness supplies the recipient condition associated with avoidance rather than uptake.

structural_cues: The adjacent clauses contrast one subject remembering with another subject avoiding the same reminder.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recollection, awe, withdrawal, and wretchedness; I infer opposed orientations toward the reminder. A live alternative is a simple classification of two audiences without a claim that awe itself turns one toward the address.

changed_reading.before: Fear is naturally a recoil response that happens to precede remembering.
changed_reading.after: Reverent fear is the capacity to stay turned toward a difficult reminder until it becomes one's own recollection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The remembering subject remains capable of a beneficial change of state, in contrast to the following suspended condition under fire that resolves into neither death nor life. Remembering becomes evidence of moral-cognitive transformability rather than content retrieval alone.

activation_trace.role: Recall supplies a live transition from latency to active awareness.
Heating that can straighten or set a thing supplies a severe transformation image.
Kindled fire supplies the environment in which the opposed subject is held.
Quiescence and extinguished activity supply one blocked endpoint.
Life as benefit and good supplies the other endpoint that the suspended condition fails to reach.

structural_cues: The avoiding subject proceeds into fire and then into a paradoxical condition of neither dying nor living.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus transition into recollection and a later blocked life-death transition; I infer that receptivity to remembrance indexes transformability. A live alternative is that the later clauses describe punishment only and offer no model of cognition.

changed_reading.before: Remembering is possession of recovered content.
changed_reading.after: Remembering is a sign that the subject is still capable of a beneficial change of state rather than being fixed in sterile suspension.

context_deltas.mechanism: Purifying growth frames a sequence in which inward recollection becomes voiced naming and then embodied worship, with flourishing as its larger result. The focus verse is a threshold in a response process rather than its endpoint.

activation_trace.role: The voiced-mention branch lets focus recollection open toward outward acknowledgment.
Reverent awe supplies the inward disposition that initiates the response.
Winning and enduring supply the larger outcome of the response sequence.
Growth and increase make purification productive rather than merely subtractive.
Purity and soundness supply the changed condition in which recollection can bear action.
Verbal mention supplies the explicit outward continuation of focus remembering.
A name as indication gives voiced remembrance a determinate referent.
Specific worship supplies the embodied action into which voiced remembrance proceeds.

structural_cues: The later sequence places purification and success before remembering the Lord's name and praying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies purification, flourishing, verbal mention, naming, and worship; I infer a movement from inward disposition through speech into practice. A live alternative is that the later traits are correlated marks of one person rather than causal stages.

changed_reading.before: The focus subject completes the response by remembering internally.
changed_reading.after: Focus recollection is the hinge by which awe becomes voiced acknowledgment, worship, and purifying growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: Choice favors what is near, while the later horizon is delayed, beneficial, and enduring. Apprehensive recollection carries that delayed horizon into present awareness, counterweighting immediate salience and revising preference.

activation_trace.role: Recall makes a non-present horizon cognitively available for present choice.
Apprehensive knowing supplies awareness of consequences beyond immediate appearance.
Preferential choice supplies the decision process that recollection can reweight.
Nearness supplies the immediate horizon whose salience biases preference.
Deferral to a later time supplies the horizon absent from immediate perception.
Inclination toward what is beneficial supplies the corrected value direction.
Endurance supplies the temporal depth that outweighs merely near value.

structural_cues: The context opposes choosing present life to a later condition explicitly described as better and more enduring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies preference, nearness, delay, benefit, and endurance; I infer that recollection imports delayed value into present choice. A live alternative is that remembering and temporal preference diagnose the same person without one causally correcting the other.

changed_reading.after: Remembering also makes a delayed and enduring future operative now, functioning as a counterselection against the merely near.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated written sheets and priority make the focus recollection a recurrence of something already inscribed and transmitted. The subject's insight is new as uptake but old as a durable communicative pattern.

activation_trace.role: Recall supplies renewed presence of content that precedes the present recipient.
A written sheet supplies durable external retention across recipients and times.
Beginning and temporal priority place the remembered pattern before the present address.
The repeated written-sheet image makes continuity concrete rather than merely asserted.

structural_cues: The closing lines repeat the sheets construction and identify them as earlier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies writing, repetition, and priority; I infer that individual recollection reenacts an older inscribed continuity. A live alternative is that the closing notice only authenticates the teaching and does not alter the psychology of the focus subject.

changed_reading.before: The subject experiences a private return of memory.
changed_reading.after: The subject's recollection is a present recurrence of a pattern retained in records before this encounter.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the root's material dryness branch inside a verb normally read as reverent fear. It remains anchored at focus word 3 and gains coherence from the pasture-to-stubble sequence, but downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for contraction stripping away freshness, not as a replacement lexical gloss.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dryness branch of the fearing root at word 3 is held beside the recall branch at word 1.

activation_trace.role: Shriveling and dryness supply a contracted state in which transient freshness has been removed.
Recall supplies the recovery of significance that survives the contraction.
Living pasture supplies the fresh state before contraction.
Pasture reduced to dry stubble supplies the contextual material analogue.

changed_reading.before: Khashya is only fear or informed awe.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material overlay, khashya is a contraction that removes lush distraction and leaves the durable residue available for recollection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the hardness and sharpness branch of the remembering root is far from ordinary recollection. It remains anchored at focus word 1 and is activated by contextual straightening and fire-treatment images, but it should be rendered as a forging analogy for resolve under awe, never as the verb's direct lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The hard and sharp branch of the remembering root at word 1 coexists with reverent awe at word 3.

activation_trace.role: Hardness, sharpness, and force supply an image of recollection acquiring a decisive edge.
Reverent pressure supplies the condition under which resolve is tested.
Straightness and completion supply the shaped result.
Fire-treatment that straightens a thing supplies the tempering process.

changed_reading.before: Remembering is a soft return of mental content.
changed_reading.after: As a qualified material analogy, recollection under awe tempers awareness into a straight and decisive capacity to respond.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant mapped stirring branch attached to the preference root. It remains focus-anchored through reminder and recollection and gives a kinetic account of resisting the near life, but downstream prose must identify it as a split-root activation rather than an etymology of the contextual verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The reminder branch of the remembering root at focus word 1 is treated as an intervention received by the awed subject.

activation_trace.role: Reminder supplies the intervention that can unsettle an established preference.
Awe supplies the receptivity that lets the intervention move the subject.
The non-dominant image of stirring something from its place supplies kinetic displacement of preference.
Nearness supplies the attractor from which preference must be dislodged.
Endurance supplies the more stable orientation toward which recollection can move choice.

changed_reading.before: Recollection merely informs an already stable chooser.
changed_reading.after: A reminder received in awe can stir preference out of fixation on the near and reorient it toward what endures.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the remembering root's narrow legal-document branch. It remains anchored at focus word 1 and is materially supported by repeated written sheets and return-to-outcome, but it should be qualified as a documentary analogy in which prior teaching becomes operative, not as a claim that the focus verb literally means executing a deed.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The legal-instrument branch of the remembering root at word 1 is read alongside the subject's apprehensive knowing at word 3.

activation_trace.role: A document recording a right supplies an image of remembered teaching as a prior claim becoming operative.
Apprehensive knowing supplies recognition that the recorded claim bears on the subject.
A written sheet supplies the documentary medium in which a prior claim can persist.
Collected sheets supply continuity and aggregation across multiple records.
Return to an outcome lets the old record become present in its eventual consequence.

changed_reading.before: The subject privately recalls an admonition.
changed_reading.after: As a contained documentary analogy, the subject recognizes an older recorded claim as presently binding and consequential.

strongest_changes: Recitation, non-forgetting, ease, reminder, and benefit turn isolated recall into an enabled relay that culminates in recipient uptake.
The contrast with lateral avoidance reverses fear-as-flight: reverent fear can keep a subject turned toward a difficult reminder.
Near preference versus delayed endurance makes recollection a temporal counterselection that renders a non-present horizon operative now.
Purification, voiced naming, and worship extend inward recollection into an embodied practice sequence.
summary.what_was_special: The trace preserved coexisting cognitive, verbal, ecological, kinetic, temporal, and documentary readings. Especially productive were the non-dominant visible-mark mapping under the name root, the non-dominant stirring mapping under preference, and the focus roots' dryness, hardness, and legal-instrument branches; each changed the reading without being promoted to an exclusive gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal arrows from measured creation to recognition, from ecological residue to memory, and from recollection to practice are reader-supplied abductive links rather than explicit syntax.
Fear, reverent awe, and figurative knowing remain live together in the focus predicate; the packet does not force one to exclude the others.
The dryness, tempering, stirring, and documentary outliers are visibly anchored but branch-distant and require the stated analogical containment.
The context may diagnose one receptive subject through correlated traits rather than narrate every delta as a temporal sequence.
